metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Since you loved Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this iconic high-school comedy features the same sharp wit and memorable characters.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: This modern teen comedy captures the literary-inspired humor of 10 Things I Hate About You with a highly charismatic lead performance.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Matches the bright, fashion-forward, and surprisingly smart protagonist energy of Clueless.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: Perfect for fans of D&D and Jumanji who want a classic, heartwarming fantasy-adventure-comedy with endless charm.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy-adventure with great romance and humor, fitting the magical tone of Fantastic Beasts and Practical Magic.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Directly aligns with Wake Up Dead Man, offering a stellar, hilarious whodunit with an incredible ensemble cast.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The direct predecessor to Wake Up Dead Man, featuring Benoit Blanc in another colorful, sunny, and comedic murder mystery.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: Combines action, fantasy, and comedy in a high-octane adventure that perfectly matches the spirit of Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A fast-paced, hilarious comedy-thriller that fits your love for mystery-comedies like Wake Up Dead Man and buddy dynamics like The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Matches the cosmic humor, ensemble charm, and fun soundtrack of Thor: Ragnarok and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: From the director of The Nice Guys, this neo-noir action-comedy features the same sharp-witted buddy chemistry and crime mystery.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: An action-packed adventure comedy set inside a video game, making it a great companion to the Jumanji films.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A delightful, lighthearted post-apocalyptic adventure that channels the fun creature-feature elements of Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: An action-adventure rom-com with a star-studded cast, reminiscent of the fun, tropical adventure vibes in Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Starring Heath Ledger from 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a highly entertaining, modern-styled medieval adventure-comedy.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: An energetic high-school rom-com based on Shakespeare, sharing a direct spiritual link with 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Directed by Taika Waititi (Thor: Ragnarok), this hilarious mockumentary offers an incredibly fun and lighthearted take on vampire lore.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Features Jim Carrey's signature physical comedy, matching the zany, high-energy charm of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Another top-tier Jim Carrey vehicle that delivers non-stop laughs and high-energy comedic timing, perfect for fans of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: If you enjoyed the boundary-pushing mockumentary humor of Sacha Baron Cohen in Brüno, this iconic original film is a must-watch.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant, high-energy buddy-cop action comedy with a mystery element that fans of The Nice Guys and Knives Out will love.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Combines action, comedy, and a highly stylized aesthetic that fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl and Thor: Ragnarok will appreciate.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful, self-aware fantasy rom-com that beautifully balances lighthearted magic with comedic romance.

metas.name: Yesterday
metas.description: A feel-good, lighthearted romantic comedy with a high-concept premise that delivers pure musical comfort.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, funny, and heartwarming time-loop rom-com that keeps things light, entertaining, and highly creative.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A blast of a horror-comedy that plays out like a fun road-trip adventure, matching the action-comedy energy of Jumanji.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious, action-packed comedy starring Melissa McCarthy that delivers great action sequences and constant laughs.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A high-octane, neon-soaked action comedy filled with quirky characters and chaotic fun, akin to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: A delightfully fun adventure mystery that delivers the same pure, high-spirited entertainment value as Jumanji.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Offers stylish, high-energy action and lighthearted spy comedy, perfect for fans of fun, fast-paced blockbusters.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A highly rewatchable, feel-good musical comedy with a charming ensemble, capturing the fun comfort vibes of Clueless.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A riotous, star-studded action-comedy that subverts action movie tropes in a highly entertaining and hilarious way.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: For a touch of romance and light fantasy, this heartwarming time-travel film provides the ultimate comfort watch.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A masterful horror-comedy that relies on witty dialogue, great buddy dynamics, and highly engaging entertainment.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A hilarious, modern teen comedy with outstanding lead chemistry, appealing directly to fans of Clueless and 10 Things.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with the heart of a 1980s family adventure, loaded with comedy and lighthearted fun.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: A fast-paced, incredibly funny Disney animated comedy with the zany, slapstick humor of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: An exceptional, star-studded ensemble romantic comedy that is incredibly charming, lighthearted, and easy to watch.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: An absolute joy of an animated film featuring high-energy action, fantastic humor, and visually stunning creativity.

metas.name: The Kid Who Would Be King
metas.description: A delightful and highly underrated modern-day fantasy adventure that captures the magical, fun-filled spirit of D&D and Jumanji.
